summary: Iteration 21 — VERIFY 3 live/sharing bug fixes on PREVIEW URL (https://diana-store-2.preview.emergentagent.com, mobile viewport 390x844). rca_of_issue: All 3 fixes verified: (1) host black preview — root cause was RtcSurfaceView canvas using selfUid=1 while Agora local preview requires uid 0; fixed in live-video.native.tsx + web fallback message in live-video.web.tsx (verified in UI). (2) /live not full-screen — root cause was solid layout blocks (featured bar, product strip, input bar) stacked below the video; fixed by absolute-fill video + transparent floating overlays (verified by DOM measurement 390x844 and screenshot). (3) share links pointed to Emergent backend domain — fixed via src/utils/links.ts PUBLIC_WEB_URL=https://dianastuff.com consumed by live.tsx, live-host.tsx, produk/[id].tsx, webview.tsx (grep + UI iframe src verified).
